svg.title: uart_top architecture
svg.desc: Block diagram of the UART peripheral: host register bus into uart_regs, TX FIFO to uart_tx, rx pin through a loopback mux to uart_rx into the RX FIFO, baud_gen timing, and uart_irq producing the irq output. Animated packets show a byte travelling TX then RX, then an interrupt.
svg.text: single clock domain · synchronous active-high reset
